Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu showcase, aur operating hours integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cafedhaba

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team Cafe The Dhaba, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Cafe The Dhaba) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

Great! We tailored it specifically with a mobile-first menu display and direct WhatsApp table booking for your Patliputra Colony location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? 

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
